title: Sole-reader guarantee: src/jwt-validator.mjs is the only module reading the Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion header
asA: shelf consumer applying the edge-cloudflare-access v1.0.0 blueprint on a Workers project using the cf-edge fixture
iWant: only src/jwt-validator.mjs to dereference the Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion header string in the applied source tree
soThat: the validator is the single seam and a stray header read in the applied code is a defect the AST scan catches

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the canonical fixture applied source root (src/**/*.mjs), when the sole-reader scan walks the tree, strips comments and string literals, and searches for live-source occurrences of the header string Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion, the scan finds exactly one live-source occurrence in src/jwt-validator.mjs and the probe returns aggregateVerdict:pass.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the cf-edge fixture applied source tree
acceptanceCriteria.then: the only live-source hit for Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion is in src/jwt-validator.mjs

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the SIMULATE_NON_VALIDATOR_HEADER=true switch (a second live-source occurrence of Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion is injected outside src/jwt-validator.mjs), when the sole-reader scan runs on the fixture applied source root, the probe returns aggregateVerdict:fail with detail naming the offending file path.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the fixture applied source root with SIMULATE_NON_VALIDATOR_HEADER=true (a second live-source hit on Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion injected outside src/jwt-validator.mjs)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the probe returns aggregateVerdict:fail with detail naming the offending file path
